blocking_findings.title: Request-controlled fixture mode bypasses real-execution disablement
blocking_findings.evidence: source/testing/first_medium_saved_output_qualification.py:299-305 trusts data_scope plus the public FIXTURE_TOKEN and does not constrain arm evidence_kind or input paths. tests/test_first_medium_saved_output_qualification.py:115-129 labels fixture data real_saved. A bounded adversarial run accepted an arbitrary outside-packet path while both real-execution flags remained false.
blocking_findings.repair: Use a separate fixture-only entry point or bind fixture mode to exact packaged fixture file hashes and a dedicated non-real evidence kind. The production CLI must reject fixture mode and all unreviewed paths before any input load. Add a negative test using a real_saved arm and arbitrary external path.

blocking_findings.title: Phase 2 accepts a fixture Phase-1 completion as its prerequisite
blocking_findings.evidence: source/testing/first_medium_saved_output_qualification.py:329-332 accepts either COMPLETE_ONE_SHOT or COMPLETE_FIXTURE. The adversarial verifier proof supplied a valid fixture packet and was accepted.
blocking_findings.repair: Require COMPLETE_ONE_SHOT only; bind and compare Phase-1 contract/request hashes and REF ACTUAL_BINDING_RECEIPT identity against the Phase-2 REF before loading B; reject fixture=true anywhere in the prerequisite chain. Add positive real-receipt and negative fixture/mismatched-REF fixtures.

blocking_findings.title: The start token is replayable across fresh namespaces
blocking_findings.evidence: source/testing/first_medium_saved_output_qualification.py:309-314 only compares supplied token strings; lines 404-423 protect a namespace but do not consume the token globally. The same start token completed twice in two fresh namespaces in a bounded synthetic proof.
blocking_findings.repair: Before input loading, atomically claim the unique start token in a fixed contract-bound registry using exclusive creation. Bind token, contract hash, request hash, output namespace, phase, and host/job identity. Preserve the claim on failure and reject every replay. Add concurrent and sequential replay fixtures.

blocking_findings.title: Resource limits are post-hoc observations rather than preflight/lifetime enforcement
blocking_findings.evidence: source/testing/first_medium_saved_output_qualification.py:357-393 checks thread declarations, elapsed wall, RSS, and output bytes only during finalization after lines 424-431 have loaded inputs, computed controls, and written bindings. A five-thread adversarial run produced PHASE1_CONTROL_REPORT and ACTUAL_BINDING_RECEIPT before failing. gpu_count is never checked.
blocking_findings.repair: Validate thread/GPU policy before input loading; run under the reviewed managed job with hard wall timeout and memory/CPU/GPU limits or explicitly downgrade post-hoc fields to diagnostics. Enforce output quota before and during writes. Persist scheduler/cgroup limits and terminal state in the resource receipt; add over-thread, timeout, memory, GPU, and output-cap fixtures.

additional_freeze_requirement.finding: The exact REF cohort has no frozen selection rule or exact ID list in this packet. _load_cohort verifies uniqueness, presence, and the caller-supplied digest only (lines 102-114).
additional_freeze_requirement.repair: Freeze an outcome-blind REF-only selection rule and exact ordered cluster-ID artifact with source identity, or bind an externally reviewed exact cohort artifact. Make the production request reference that artifact rather than accepting an arbitrary present-unit subset.
